public_rationale: At the May 16, 2023 Senate hearing, Altman endorsed an oversight agency in an exchange about licensing [e1]. In his March 20, 2025 interview, he expressed reduced expectations that frontier safety regulation would be adopted, while still calling frontier safety testing good policy [e2]. This comparison does not establish repeated substantive retreats by April 6, 2025, but it also cannot settle whether he withdrew other Senate commitments [e1, e2].
limitations: The supplied claim does not identify the particular Senate statements at issue.
The packet provides one later interview and does not establish repeated retreats.
Continued support for frontier safety testing does not settle whether Altman retained every part of his earlier oversight proposal.
